# Optional repository templates

These files are intentionally not active GitHub configuration. Copy/customize them only after repository discovery.

- `dependabot.yml.example` — choose only package ecosystems and directories that actually exist.
- `CODEOWNERS.example` — replace placeholder teams/users with real repository owners.
- `ci.yml.example` — starting point for a project-specific CI workflow.

Use `.github/prompts/generate-project-config.prompt.md` to generate project-specific versions from the detected repository.
